events.context: Initial text describes a scenario with Tree, appendage issues, and conflicting advice from doctors/parents (Scythe/surgery) and a small cat (topical treatment).
Tree hears advice to use Scythe (surgery), becomes mentally unstable, and starts making small cats.
Tree turns into a bear due to stress and appendage issues.
Small cat advises topical treatment, not Scythe, to save appendage and reverse issues.
Appendage is saved, but Tree remains a bear with ongoing issues (whip and snake use).
Scythe is revealed to be a surgical knife, indicating surgery is the extreme solution advocated by doctors/parents.
Tree is caught between three forces: doctors/parents (surgery), small cat (topical), and own desire to make small cats.
Small cat observes the ongoing struggle: Tree as a bear using whip and snake, appendage issues persist, and Scythe option remains.
Text ends with a question to Tree about choosing between options, highlighting the unresolved conflict.
